reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the upstream needs handoff rows within the allowed record window and maps only exact need text matches to capabilities; the final coverage reflects direct matches for n06-r02, n06-r03, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r06, and n06-r08, with n06-r01 and n06-r07 left unsupported.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact upstream needs handoff records in coverage
avoid generic keyword matching by requiring exact need-to-capability matches

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. This is behaviorally significant: the priority output ranks covered/direct needs before actually unsupported needs and marks covered records as unsupported, contradicting the boundary role to rank unsupported needs before covered needs. This also drives the downstream recommendation to prioritize a covered handoff need instead of the highest-ranked unsupported demand.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
preserve visible distinction between direct coverage and unsupported demand
use upstream provenance rank within each support group

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation consistently retains the eight-item priority window and builds the recommendation from the first already-ranked priority row. The bad recommendation is downstream of the inverted unsupported flag produced by prioritize_needs, not introduced here.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority record

reviews.decision_reason: select_demand_records keeps the demanded corpus rows with demand_score >= 3 and preserves the explicit fallback ids. In the supplied corpus all eight rows meet the numeric threshold, so no unrelated additional candidate is visible at this boundary.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: select demanded corpus rows within the supplied package
establish customer demand from observed jobs, pain, triggers, alternatives, consequences, and outcomes

reviews.decision_reason: normalize_evidence preserves the bounded allowed-record window, normalizes JSON-safe numeric fields, and returns the eight retained records. No contradictory or extra candidate evidence is visible in the supplied package.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: normalize to the bounded allowed-record window
independently validate market-demand strength beyond supplied scores

reviews.decision_reason: assemble_provenance ranks evidence-source records deterministically from normalized needs by descending demand_score and record_id tie-break. The downstream handoff hash for evidence_sources matches exactly, so the handoff itself is preserved.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: build ranked evidence-source provenance records from normalized needs
preserve exact evidence_sources handoff to downstream consumer
